visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt and light-colored overalls with a pink lanyard, stands outdoors in front of a white signage featuring a black stylized logo and the word 'KURA'. She smiles broadly while gesturing toward the sign, the lighting is bright and natural daylight. (2) Inside a brightly lit restaurant, a close-up shot shows a hand interacting with a digital ordering screen mounted at a table; the interface displays options for a 'Bikkurapon' game with various buttons in Japanese and Chinese. (3) The scene shifts to the woman and a man with black hair and a white t-shirt sitting at a wooden table, eating plates of sushi and bowls of noodles. A fast-paced montage follows, showing them consuming numerous plates of sushi in a time-lapse style with blurred movements. (4) Close-up shots of a smartphone screen and the table-top monitor show animated cartoon characters playing a lottery game; a blue capsule machine above the table dispenses small plastic capsules whenever the game on the screen shows a winning result. (5) The woman and man hold up small plastic-wrapped merchandise, including keychains and pins featuring round cartoon animal characters, smiling and showing them directly to the camera within the brightly lit indoor restaurant setting.
